    ∃ S : Finset ℂ, S.card = k ∧
    (∀ t ∈ S, t ^ k = w) ∧
    (∀ t, t ^ k = w → t ∈ S)

name: AnalyticLocalMapping.analyticAt_kthRoot
statement:
theorem analyticAt_kthRoot (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (u : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ)
    (hu : AnalyticAt ℂ u z₀) (hu0 : u z₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ v z₀ ∧ v z₀ ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 z₀, v z ^ k = u z

name: AnalyticLocalMapping.exists_local_power_form
statement:
theorem exists_local_power_form (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g z₀) (_hg0 : g z₀ = 0)
    (hord : analyticOrderNatAt g z₀ = k)
    (hord_ne_top : analyticOrderAt g z₀ ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ φ z₀ ∧ φ z₀ = 0 ∧ deriv φ z₀ ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 z₀, g z = φ z ^ k

name: AnalyticLocalMapping.exists_local_biholomorphism_strong
statement:
theorem exists_local_biholomorphism_strong (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ)
    (hφ : AnalyticAt ℂ φ z₀) (hφ' : deriv φ z₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ z₀ ∈ U ∧
    ∃ W : Set ℂ, IsOpen W ∧ φ z₀ ∈ W ∧
    InjOn φ U ∧
    W ⊆ φ '' U ∧
    (∀ z ∈ U, φ z ∈ W) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ U, AnalyticAt ℂ φ z) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ U, deriv φ z ≠ 0)

name: AnalyticLocalMapping.analyticOrderNatAt_pow_sub_at_simple_root
statement:
theorem analyticOrderNatAt_pow_sub_at_simple_root
    (φ : ℂ → ℂ) (z' : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (w : ℂ)
    (hφ : AnalyticAt ℂ φ z') (hφ' : deriv φ z' ≠ 0)
    (hroot : φ z' ^ k = w) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    analyticOrderNatAt (fun z => φ z ^ k - w) z' = 1

name: AnalyticLocalMapping.analytic_local_mapping_theorem
statement:
theorem analytic_local_mapping_theorem (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    {N : Set ℂ} (hN_open : IsOpen N) (hz₀N : z₀ ∈ N)
    (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g z₀) (hg0 : g z₀ = 0)
    (hord : analyticOrderNatAt g z₀ = k)
    (hord_ne_top : analyticOrderAt g z₀ ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ z₀ ∈ U ∧
    U ⊆ N ∧
    ∃ V : Set ℂ, IsOpen V ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∈ V ∧
    ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ 0 →
    ∃ S : Finset ℂ, S.card = k ∧ ↑S ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ z' ∈ S, g z' = w ∧ analyticOrderNatAt (fun z => g z - w) z' = 1) ∧
      (∀ z' ∈ U, g z' = w → z' ∈ S)

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.HasLocalKfoldRamification
statement:
structure HasLocalKfoldRamification (f : X → Y) : Prop where
  local_kfold_ramified :
    ∀ [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ) ω X] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ) ω Y]
      {x : X} {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → mapAnalyticOrderAt f x = k →
      ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ V : Set Y, IsOpen V ∧ f x ∈ V ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, y ≠ f x →
      ∃ s : Finset X, s.card = k ∧ ↑s ⊆ U ∧
        (∀ x' ∈ s, f x' = y ∧ mapAnalyticOrderAt f x' = 1) ∧
        (∀ x' ∈ U, f x' = y → x' ∈ s)
variables:
variable {X Y Z : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
  [TopologicalSpace Y] [ChartedSpace ℂ Y]
  [TopologicalSpace Z] [ChartedSpace ℂ Z]

      {x : X} {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → mapAnalyticOrderAt f x = k →
      ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ V : Set Y, IsOpen V ∧ f x ∈ V ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, y ≠ f x →
      ∃ s : Finset X, s.card = k ∧ ↑s ⊆ U ∧
        (∀ x' ∈ s, f x' = y ∧ mapAnalyticOrderAt f x' = 1) ∧
        (∀ x' ∈ U, f x' = y → x' ∈ s)
variables:
variable {X Y Z : Type*}

      [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [PreconnectedSpace X] [T2Space Y],
      (¬ ∃ y₀ : Y, ∀ x, f x = y₀) →
      (finite_fiber : ∀ y : Y, (f ⁻¹' {y}).Finite) →
      ∀ y₀ : Y, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀,

        (Finset.sum (finite_fiber y₀).toFinset (mapAnalyticOrderAt f))

    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hram : mapAnalyticOrderAt f x = k) :

    ∃ s : Finset X, s.card = k ∧ ↑s ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ x' ∈ s, f x' = y ∧ mapAnalyticOrderAt f x' = 1) ∧
      (∀ x' ∈ U, f x' = y → x' ∈ s)

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.HolomorphicOneFormBanachData
statement:
structure HolomorphicOneFormBanachData
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X] where
  /-- The norm function on the section space. -/
  toNorm : Norm (HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X)
  /--
The metric-space structure realising the uniform-on-compacts
  topology.
-/
  toMetricSpace : MetricSpace (HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X)
  /--
The metric is induced by the norm via the existing additive
  structure.
-/
  dist_eq : ∀ x y : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X,
    @dist _ toMetricSpace.toDist x y = toNorm.norm (x - y)
  /--
The norm satisfies the `NormedSpace` scalar bound over the existing
  `Module ℂ` structure.
-/
  norm_smul_le : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X),
    toNorm.norm (c • x) ≤ ‖c‖ * toNorm.norm x
  /--
The chosen norm makes the section space a Banach space (complete
  in the metric-induced uniformity).
-/
  complete :
    @CompleteSpace (HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X)
      toMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
  /--
Pointwise upper bound: the fiber norm of `σ.1 x` is at most
  the global norm of `σ`.  This connects the abstract norm to
  pointwise section evaluation; without it, an arbitrary Banach
  norm need not make the closed unit ball compact (so
  `holomorphicOneForm_montel` is not provable from
  `toNorm`/`toMetricSpace`/`complete` alone).
-/
  norm_le : ∀ (σ : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X) (x : X),
    ‖σ.1 x‖ ≤ toNorm.norm σ

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.HolomorphicOneFormBanachData.toNormedAddCommGroup
statement:
noncomputable abbrev toNormedAddCommGroup : NormedAddCommGroup (HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X) where
  norm := B.toNorm.norm
  toAddCommGroup := ContMDiffSection.instAddCommGroup
  toMetricSpace := B.toMetricSpace
  dist_eq := fun x y => by
    rw [@dist_comm _ B.toMetricSpace.toPseudoMetricSpace x y, B.dist_eq y x,
      show y - x = -x + y by abel]

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.BranchedCoverData
statement:
structure BranchedCoverData
    (X Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) where
  /-- Local ramification / mapping multiplicity at each point. -/
  ramificationIndex : X → ℕ
  /-- Multiplicities are positive. -/
  ramificationIndex_pos : ∀ x, 0 < ramificationIndex x
  /--
Every fibre is finite (a deep fact for nonconstant holomorphic
  maps between compact Riemann surfaces).
-/
  finite_fiber : ∀ y : Y, (f ⁻¹' {y}).Finite
  /--
The weighted fibre count is constant on `Y` (the genuinely
  nontrivial part of the definition); stated directly via the fibre
  sum so that `branchedDegree_eq_weightedFiberCard` is unconditional.
-/
  fiberSum_const :
    ∀ y₁ y₂ : Y,
      ((finite_fiber y₁).toFinset).sum ramificationIndex
        = ((finite_fiber y₂).toFinset).sum ramificationIndex
  /-- The source-side branch locus is finite. -/
  ramified_finite : {x : X | ramificationIndex x ≠ 1}.Finite
  /-- At an unramified point, the cover is locally bijective. -/
  local_bijective_unramified :
    ∀ x : X, ramificationIndex x = 1 →
      ∃ U : Set X, ∃ V : Set Y,
        IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ U ∧ f x ∈ V ∧ Set.BijOn f U V

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.BranchedCoverData.RamificationIndexCompatible
statement:
def BranchedCoverData.RamificationIndexCompatible
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [ChartedSpace ℂ X] [ChartedSpace ℂ Y]
    {f : X → Y} (h : BranchedCoverData X Y f) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : X, IsHolomorphicAt f x → h.ramificationIndex x = mapAnalyticOrderAt f x

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.BranchedCoverData.ramificationIndex_eq_mapAnalyticOrderAt
statement:
theorem BranchedCoverData.ramificationIndex_eq_mapAnalyticOrderAt
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [ChartedSpace ℂ X] [ChartedSpace ℂ Y]
    {f : X → Y} {h : BranchedCoverData X Y f}
    (hcompat : h.RamificationIndexCompatible)
    {x : X} (hf : IsHolomorphicAt f x) :
    h.ramificationIndex x = mapAnalyticOrderAt f x

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.BranchedCoverData.localInverseAt
statement:
noncomputable def BranchedCoverData.localInverseAt
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Nonempty X]
    {f : X → Y} (h : BranchedCoverData X Y f) (x : X)
    (hx : h.ramificationIndex x = 1) : Y → X :=
  Function.invFunOn f (h.local_bijective_unramified x hx).choose

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.BranchedCoverData.localInverse_is_inverse
statement:
theorem BranchedCoverData.localInverse_is_inverse
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Nonempty X]
    {f : X → Y} (h : BranchedCoverData X Y f) {x : X}
    (hx : h.ramificationIndex x = 1) :
    ∃ U : Set X, ∃ V : Set Y,
      IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ U ∧ f x ∈ V ∧
      Set.BijOn f U V ∧
      (∀ y' ∈ V, f (h.localInverseAt x hx y') = y') ∧
      (∀ x' ∈ U, h.localInverseAt x hx (f x') = x')

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.BranchedCoverData.weightedFiberCard
statement:
noncomputable def BranchedCoverData.weightedFiberCard
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f : X → Y} (h : BranchedCoverData X Y f) (y : Y) : ℕ :=
  ((h.finite_fiber y).toFinset).sum h.ramificationIndex

statement:
theorem branchedDegree_eq_card_toFinset_of_unramified_fiber
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f : X → Y} [Nonempty Y] (h : BranchedCoverData X Y f) (y : Y)
    (hunram : ∀ x ∈ f ⁻¹' {y}, h.ramificationIndex x = 1) :

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.MeromorphicMapToSphere
statement:
structure MeromorphicMapToSphere
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X] where
  toMap : X → OnePoint ℂ
  locally_meromorphic : Prop
  zeroDivisor : Divisor X
  poleDivisor : Divisor X
  principalDivisor : Divisor X
  principalDivisor_eq : principalDivisor = zeroDivisor - poleDivisor
  /--
The pole divisor of a meromorphic function has nonneg coefficients
  pointwise.  This is the structural fact behind `Divisor.Effective f.poles`.
-/
  poleDivisor_nonneg : ∀ P : X, 0 ≤ poleDivisor P
  /--
A point cannot simultaneously be a zero and a pole of a meromorphic
  function.  This expresses the disjoint-support property of the
  zero/pole divisor decomposition.
-/
  zero_or_pole_eq_zero : ∀ Q : X, zeroDivisor Q = 0 ∨ poleDivisor Q = 0
  /--
Off the pole locus a meromorphic-map-to-sphere takes finite values
  in `OnePoint ℂ`.  Combined with continuity below, this captures that
  poles are exactly the preimage of `∞`.
-/
  toMap_ne_infty_of_poleDivisor_zero :
    ∀ x : X, poleDivisor x = 0 → toMap x ≠ (OnePoint.infty : OnePoint ℂ)
  /--
A meromorphic-map-to-sphere is continuous on the locus of finite
  values (i.e. the complement of its pole set).  This is the
  `OnePoint`-restricted form of the classical "holomorphic away from
  poles ⇒ continuous".
-/
  continuousOn_ne_infty :
    ContinuousOn toMap {x : X | toMap x ≠ (OnePoint.infty : OnePoint ℂ)}
  /--
Any global complex-valued lift of `toMap` through the canonical
  inclusion `ℂ → OnePoint ℂ` is `MDifferentiable`.  This implements
  "holomorphic ⇒ smooth" for the lifted map.
-/
  toFiniteFun_mdifferentiable :
    ∀ g : X → ℂ,
      toMap = (fun x => ((g x : ℂ) : OnePoint ℂ)) →
      MDifferentiable (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) g
  /--
At a (positive-order) pole of a meromorphic-map-to-sphere, the map
  evaluates to `∞ : OnePoint ℂ`.
-/
  toMap_eq_infty_of_poleDivisor_pos :
    ∀ P : X, 0 < poleDivisor P → toMap P = (OnePoint.infty : OnePoint ℂ)

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.MeromorphicMapToSphere.AnalyticData
statement:
structure AnalyticData (f : MeromorphicMapToSphere X) where
  /-- Global continuity of the map to `OnePoint ℂ`. -/
  continuous_toMap : Continuous f.toMap
  /--
The canonical finite lift `(f.toMap ·).getD 0` is meromorphic at
  every point in the manifold sense.
-/
  meromorphic_getD :
    ∀ p : X,
      JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.MeromorphicAtX
        (fun q => (f.toMap q).getD 0) p
  /--
At a *simple* pole, the chart-local analytic order of `f.toMap`
  is exactly `1`. This is the analytic content
  "simple pole ⇒ ramification index one".
-/
  simple_pole_order_one :
    ∀ P : X,
      f.poles = Divisor.point P →
        JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.mapAnalyticOrderAt f.toMap P = 1

structure SimplePoleToSphereData
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X]
    (P : X) where
  /--
A global complex-valued lift, defined on all of `X` (the value at
  `P` is arbitrary; only off-`P` values matter for `toMap`).
-/
  finiteLift : X → ℂ
  /-- The map to the Riemann sphere. -/
  toMap : X → OnePoint ℂ
  /-- At `P`, `toMap` is `∞`. -/
  toMap_at_pole : toMap P = OnePoint.infty
  /-- Off `P`, `toMap` is the canonical complex coordinate of `finiteLift`. -/
  toMap_off_pole : ∀ x : X, x ≠ P → toMap x = ((finiteLift x : ℂ) : OnePoint ℂ)
  /-- Global continuity of `toMap` into `OnePoint ℂ`. -/
  continuous_toMap : Continuous toMap
  /--
The finite lift is meromorphic at every point of `X` (in the
  manifold sense).
-/
  meromorphic_finiteLift :
    ∀ p : X,
      JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.MeromorphicAtX
        finiteLift p
  /-- At `P`, the chart-local analytic order of `toMap` is `1`. -/
  simple_pole_order :
    JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.mapAnalyticOrderAt toMap P = 1
  /-- `‖finiteLift x‖ → ∞` as `x → P` in the punctured neighborhood. -/
  pole_modulus :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x => ‖finiteLift x‖) (nhdsWithin P {P}ᶜ) Filter.atTop

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.RiemannRochSectionAtPoint
statement:
structure RiemannRochSectionAtPoint
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X]
    (P : X) where
  /-- The Riemann-Roch section as a complex-valued function. -/
  finiteLift : X → ℂ
  /-- The section is meromorphic at every point of `X`. -/
  meromorphic_everywhere :
    ∀ p : X,
      JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.MeromorphicAtX finiteLift p
  /--
Off the prescribed pole, the section has nonnegative chart-local
  vanishing order — i.e. no poles outside `P`. This is the divisor
  bound `(finiteLift) ≥ -[P]` at every point `p ≠ P`.
-/
  noPoleOff_P :
    ∀ p : X, p ≠ P →
      0 ≤ JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.orderAt p finiteLift
  /--
At `P`, the section has chart-local vanishing order exactly `-1`
  — a simple pole.
-/
  orderAt_P_eq_neg_one :
    JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.orderAt P finiteLift = (-1 : ℤ)
  /-- The one-point extension is continuous on `OnePoint ℂ`. -/
  continuous_extension : Continuous (onePointExtend finiteLift P)
  /--
The chart-local analytic order of the one-point extension at `P`
  (read in the inversion chart on `OnePoint ℂ`) is `1`.
-/
  orderAt_pole_in_extension :
    JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.mapAnalyticOrderAt
      (onePointExtend finiteLift P) P = 1
  /-- The modulus of the section diverges at `P`. -/
  modulus_tendsto :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x => ‖finiteLift x‖) (nhdsWithin P {P}ᶜ) Filter.atTop

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.PointRiemannRochSection
statement:
structure PointRiemannRochSection
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X]
    (P : X) where
  /-- The section as a complex-valued function. -/
  finiteLift : X → ℂ
  /-- Meromorphic at every point of `X`. -/
  meromorphic_everywhere :
    ∀ p : X,
      JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.MeromorphicAtX finiteLift p
  /--
Off the prescribed pole, the literal point values of `finiteLift` agree
  with their removable holomorphic germs, so the finite lift is continuous.
-/
  finiteLift_continuous_off_P :
    ∀ p : X, p ≠ P → ContinuousAt finiteLift p
  /-- Divisor bound at `P`: `orderAt P finiteLift ≥ -1`. -/
  order_ge_neg_one_at_P :
    ((-1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤
      JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.orderAt P finiteLift
  /-- No poles off `P`: `orderAt p finiteLift ≥ 0` for `p ≠ P`. -/
  noPoleOff_P :
    ∀ p : X, p ≠ P →
      (0 : WithTop ℤ) ≤
        JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.VanishingOrder.orderAt p finiteLift
  /--
The germ of `finiteLift` at `P` is not constant on a punctured
  neighborhood. Equivalent (for meromorphic functions) to "the order at
  `P` is not `0` or `⊤`", i.e. there is a real singularity or zero at
  `P`. The weakest condition that is still satisfied by an element of
  `L(P)` with a true simple pole at `P` and ruled out by a literal
  constant.
-/
  outside_constants :
    ¬ ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] P, finiteLift z = c

    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ)

  inv : F →L[ℂ] E
  left_inv : inv.comp f = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E
  right_inv : f.comp inv = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ F

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.cotangentPushforward
statement:
noncomputable def cotangentPushforward
    (f : X → Y) (x : X) (ωx : CotangentSpace ℂ X x) :
    CotangentSpace ℂ Y (f x) :=
  if h : Nonempty (IsIso (mfderiv 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) f x)) then
    ωx.comp (Classical.choice h).inv
  else
    0
variables: variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Nonempty X]
variable [ChartedSpace ℂ X] [ChartedSpace ℂ Y]

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.traceAtRegularValue
statement:

    {f : X → Y} (h : BranchedCoverData X Y f)
    (ω : ∀ x, CotangentSpace ℂ X x)
    (y : Y) (_hy : isRegularValue h y) : CotangentSpace ℂ Y y :=
  let s := (h.finite_fiber y).toFinset
  Finset.sum s.attach (fun x => cotangentPushforward f x.1 (ω x.1))

    (hcompat : hbc.RamificationIndexCompatible)
    (hHol : IsHolomorphic f)
    {x : X} (hx_unram : hbc.ramificationIndex x = 1)

    cotangentPushforward f x ωx =
      ωx.comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ
          ((deriv (chartLocalAt f x) (chartAt ℂ x x))⁻¹) :
          TangentSpace 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) (f x) →L[ℂ] TangentSpace 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) x)

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.TraceChartData
statement:
structure TraceChartData (y₀ : Y) where
  ρ : ℝ
  ρ_pos : 0 < ρ
  ball_sub : ball (chartAt ℂ y₀ y₀) ρ ⊆ (chartAt ℂ y₀).target
  U : X → Set X
  r : X → ℝ
  U_open : ∀ x, IsOpen (U x)
  mem_U : ∀ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, x ∈ U x
  U_sub_source : ∀ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, U x ⊆ (chartAt ℂ x).source
  U_sub_ball : ∀ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, ∀ x' ∈ U x, chartAt ℂ x x' ∈ ball (chartAt ℂ x x) (r x)
  ballX_sub : ∀ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, ball (chartAt ℂ x x) (r x) ⊆ (chartAt ℂ x).target
  disj : ∀ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, ∀ x' ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, x ≠ x' → Disjoint (U x) (U x')
  cover : ∀ w ∈ ball (chartAt ℂ y₀ y₀) ρ, ∀ x', f x' = (chartAt ℂ y₀).symm w →
    ∃ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀, x' ∈ U x
  kfold : ∀ w ∈ ball (chartAt ℂ y₀ y₀) ρ, w ≠ chartAt ℂ y₀ y₀ → ∀ x ∈ fiberFin hfin y₀,
    ((fiberFin hfin ((chartAt ℂ y₀).symm w)).filter (· ∈ U x)).card = mapAnalyticOrderAt f x ∧
    ∀ x' ∈ (fiberFin hfin ((chartAt ℂ y₀).symm w)).filter (· ∈ U x),
      mapAnalyticOrderAt f x' = 1

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.dz

    (hβc : ∀ n, ContFam (β n)) {r : A.L2}
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => A.toL2 (β n) (hβc n)) atTop (𝓝 r)) {R : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hRi : IntegrableOn R (A.D k)) (hR : L1Conv (fun n => β n (A.p k)) R (A.D k))
    {φ : ℂ → ℂ} (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hs : tsupport φ ⊆ ball (A.ctr k) (3 / 2 * A.r k)) :
    ∫ w in A.D k, (starRingEnd ℂ) (dbar φ w) * R w =
      ⟪A.toL2 (dbarF (extend (A.p k) φ))
        (smoothFam_dbarF (A.isSmooth_extend_test k hφ hs)).contFam, r⟫_ℂ

    (hRi : IntegrableOn R (A.D k)) (hR : L1Conv (fun n => β n (A.p k)) R (A.D k))
    (horth : ∀ u (hu : IsSmooth u), ⟪A.toL2 (dbarF u) (smoothFam_dbarF hu).contFam, r⟫_ℂ = 0) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ G (ball (A.ctr k) (3 / 2 * A.r k)) ∧

statement:
theorem chart_compat (k l : Fin A.N) {β : ℕ → X → ℂ → ℂ} (hβ : ∀ n, Is01 (β n))
    (hβc : ∀ n, ContFam (β n)) {Gk Gl : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hGk : DifferentiableOn ℂ Gk (ball (A.ctr k) (3 / 2 * A.r k)))
    (hGl : DifferentiableOn ℂ Gl (ball (A.ctr l) (3 / 2 * A.r l)))
    (hik : ∀ n, IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖β n (A.p k) z - (starRingEnd ℂ) (Gk z)‖)
      (ball (A.ctr k) (3 / 2 * A.r k)))
    (hil : ∀ n, IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖β n (A.p l) z - (starRingEnd ℂ) (Gl z)‖)
      (ball (A.ctr l) (3 / 2 * A.r l)))
    (hk : L1Conv (fun n => β n (A.p k)) (fun z => (starRingEnd ℂ) (Gk z))
      (ball (A.ctr k) (3 / 2 * A.r k)))
    (hl : L1Conv (fun n => β n (A.p l)) (fun z => (starRingEnd ℂ) (Gl z))
      (ball (A.ctr l) (3 / 2 * A.r l)))
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ ball (A.ctr k) (3 / 2 * A.r k)) (hwo : w ∈ overlap (A.p k) (A.p l))
    (hwl : trans (A.p k) (A.p l) w ∈ ball (A.ctr l) (3 / 2 * A.r l)) :
    Gk w = deriv (trans (A.p k) (A.p l)) w * Gl (trans (A.p k) (A.p l) w)

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy
statement:
def L1Cauchy (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (K : Set ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ > 0, ∃ N, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∫ z in K, ‖f n z - f m z‖ < δ

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy.mono
statement:
theorem L1Cauchy.mono {f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {K K' : Set ℂ} (hK' : K' ⊆ K)
    (hint : ∀ n m, IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖f n z - f m z‖) K) (h : L1Cauchy f K) :
    L1Cauchy f K'

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy.add
statement:
theorem L1Cauchy.add {f g : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {K : Set ℂ}
    (hfi : ∀ n m, IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖f n z - f m z‖) K)
    (hgi : ∀ n m, IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖g n z - g m z‖) K)
    (hf : L1Cauchy f K) (hg : L1Cauchy g K) : L1Cauchy (fun n z => f n z + g n z) K

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy.neg
statement:
theorem L1Cauchy.neg {f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} (hf : L1Cauchy f K) :

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy.const
statement:
theorem L1Cauchy.const {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hc : CauchySeq c) {K : Set ℂ} (_hK : volume K < ⊤) :

    (h : L1Cauchy (fun n _ => c n) K) : CauchySeq c

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy.comp_holo
statement:
theorem L1Cauchy.comp_holo {f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {τ : ℂ → ℂ} {B K : Set ℂ}
    (hB : IsCompact B) (hBm : MeasurableSet B) (hτd : ∀ w ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℂ τ w)
    (hτc : ContinuousOn (deriv τ) B) (hinj : InjOn τ B) (hd : ∀ w ∈ B, deriv τ w ≠ 0)
    (hτB : τ '' B ⊆ K) (hfc : ∀ n m, ContinuousOn (fun w => f n (τ w) - f m (τ w)) B)
    (hint : ∀ n m, IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖f n z - f m z‖) K) (h : L1Cauchy f K) :
    L1Cauchy (fun n => f n ∘ τ) B

name: JacobianChallenge.Surface.L1Cauchy.exists_lim
statement:
theorem L1Cauchy.exists_lim {f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} (hint : ∀ n, IntegrableOn (f n) K)
    (h : L1Cauchy f K) : ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, IntegrableOn F K ∧ L1Conv f F K

      (𝓝 (A.toL2 e hes.contFam))) {c : ℕ → ℂ} {V : ℂ → ℂ} (hVi : IntegrableOn V (A.Q k))
    (hV : L1Conv (fun n w => rd (u n) (A.p k) w - c n) V (A.Q k))
    {φ : ℂ → ℂ} (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφs : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφt : tsupport φ ⊆ A.Qo k) :

      (𝓝 (A.toL2 e hes.contFam))) {c : ℕ → ℂ} {V : ℂ → ℂ} (hVi : IntegrableOn V (A.Q k))
    (hV : L1Conv (fun n w => rd (u n) (A.p k) w - c n) V (A.Q k)) :
    ∃ S : ℂ → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ S (A.Qo k) ∧ (∀ w ∈ A.Qo k, dbar S w = e (A.p k) w) ∧
      ∀ᵐ w, w ∈ A.Qo k → V w = S w

    {Vk Vl Sk Sl : ℂ → ℂ} (hVki : IntegrableOn Vk (A.Q k)) (hVli : IntegrableOn Vl (A.Q l))
    (hVk : L1Conv (fun n w => rd (u n) (A.p k) w - c n) Vk (A.Q k))
    (hVl : L1Conv (fun n w => rd (u n) (A.p l) w - c n) Vl (A.Q l))
    (hSk : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Sk (A.Qo k)) (hSl : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Sl (A.Qo l))
    (hk : ∀ᵐ w, w ∈ A.Qo k → Vk w = Sk w) (hl : ∀ᵐ w, w ∈ A.Qo l → Vl w = Sl w)
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ A.Qo k) (hwo : w ∈ overlap (A.p k) (A.p l))
    (hwl : trans (A.p k) (A.p l) w ∈ A.Qo l) :
    Sk w = Sl (trans (A.p k) (A.p l) w)

  source : Set X
  isOpen_source : IsOpen source
  targetChart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (OnePoint ℂ) ℂ
  targetChart_standard : targetChart = identityChart ∨ targetChart = inversionChart
  coord : X → ℂ

structure GenusZeroGlobalGluingData
    (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    [ConnectedSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X] where
  PatchIndex : Type
  patch_fintype : Fintype PatchIndex
  patch_nonempty : Nonempty PatchIndex
  patch : PatchIndex → GenusZeroGlobalGluingPatch X
  patch_cover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : PatchIndex, x ∈ (patch i).source
  target_chart_cover :
    ∀ y : OnePoint ℂ, ∃ (i : PatchIndex) (z : ℂ),
      z ∈ (patch i).targetChart.target ∧ y = (patch i).targetChart.symm z
  toMap : X → OnePoint ℂ
  invMap : OnePoint ℂ → X
  target_mem_on_patch :
    ∀ i x, x ∈ (patch i).source → toMap x ∈ (patch i).targetChart.source
  chart_expression_on_patch :
    ∀ i x, x ∈ (patch i).source →
      (patch i).targetChart (toMap x) = (patch i).coord x
  overlap_compatible :
    ∀ i j x,
      x ∈ (patch i).source → x ∈ (patch j).source →
        (patch i).targetChart.symm ((patch i).coord x) =
          (patch j).targetChart.symm ((patch j).coord x)
  inverse_branch_agrees_on_patch :
    ∀ i z, z ∈ (patch i).targetChart.target →
      invMap ((patch i).targetChart.symm z) = (patch i).invCoord z
  local_left_inverse_on_patch :
    ∀ i x, x ∈ (patch i).source → invMap (toMap x) = x
  local_right_inverse_on_target_chart :
    ∀ i z, z ∈ (patch i).targetChart.target →
      toMap ((patch i).invCoord z) = (patch i).targetChart.symm z
  contMDiff_toMap :
    ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ)
      (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) toMap
  contMDiff_invMap :
    ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ)
      (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) invMap

statement:
theorem localInverse_is_inverse
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    [ConnectedSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X]
    (route : GenusZeroDegreeOneBiholomorphicRoute X) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : Set X, ∃ V : Set (OnePoint ℂ),
      IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ U ∧ route.meromorphicMap.toMap x ∈ V ∧
      Set.BijOn route.meromorphicMap.toMap U V ∧
      (∀ y' ∈ V,
        route.meromorphicMap.toMap
            (route.branchedCoverData.localInverseAt x
              (route.ramificationIndex_eq_one x) y') = y') ∧
      (∀ x' ∈ U,
        route.branchedCoverData.localInverseAt x
            (route.ramificationIndex_eq_one x)
            (route.meromorphicMap.toMap x') = x')

        A.integral (fun p w => (starRingEnd ℂ) (holoF ν p w) * holoF η p w) =
          (Real.pi : ℂ) * integral Γ η) ∧

    [NormedSpace ℂ V]
    (Λ : FullComplexLattice V) (v₁ v₂ : V) {δ r : ℝ}
    (hδpos : 0 < δ)
    (hr_lt : r < δ / 2)
    (hiso : ∀ g ∈ Λ.subgroup, g ≠ 0 → δ ≤ ‖g‖)
    {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball v₁ r ∩ mk V Λ ⁻¹' (mk V Λ '' Metric.ball v₂ r)) :
    ∃ U ∈ nhdsWithin x
        (Metric.ball v₁ r ∩ mk V Λ ⁻¹' (mk V Λ '' Metric.ball v₂ r)),
      ∀ y ∈ U,
        localSection Λ v₂ r (mk V Λ y) =
          y + (localSection Λ v₂ r (mk V Λ x) - x)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.edgeArcIdx
statement:
def edgeArcIdx (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * (g + 1))) : ℕ :=
  4 * (i.val / 2) + (i.val % 2)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.boundaryAngle_continuous
statement:
lemma boundaryAngle_continuous (g i : ℕ) :

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.edgeContMap
statement:
noncomputable def edgeContMap (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * (g + 1))) :
    C(unitInterval, Polygon4g (g + 1)) where
  toFun := fun t =>
    Polygon4g.mk (g + 1) (boundaryParam (g + 1) (edgeArcIdx g i) t.val)
  continuous_toFun := by
    refine (Polygon4g.mk_continuous _).comp ?_
    refine (boundaryParam_continuous _ _).comp ?_
    exact continuous_subtype_val

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.edgeContMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma edgeContMap_apply (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * (g + 1))) (t : unitInterval) :

      Polygon4g.mk (g + 1) (boundaryParam (g + 1) (edgeArcIdx g i) t.val)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.stdSimplexToUnitInterval
statement:

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.edgeSimplex
statement:
noncomputable def edgeSimplex (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * (g + 1))) :
    C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin 2), Polygon4g (g + 1)) :=

        (boundaryParam (g + 1) (edgeArcIdx g i)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.SingSimplex
statement:
abbrev SingSimplex (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] : Type :=
  C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.SingSimplexCat
statement:
abbrev SingSimplexCat (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] : Type :=
  (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).obj (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk n))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singSimplexEquiv
statement:
noncomputable def singSimplexEquiv (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    SingSimplexCat n X ≃ SingSimplex n X :=
  TopCat.toSSetObjEquiv (TopCat.of X) (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk n))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain
statement:
abbrev singChain (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] : ModuleCat ℤ :=
  (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj
      (TopCat.of X)).X n

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_eq_coproduct
statement:
theorem singChain_eq_coproduct (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    singChain n X = (∐ fun _ : SingSimplexCat n X => ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_basisCat
statement:
noncomputable def singChain_basisCat {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (σ : SingSimplexCat n X) : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ singChain n X :=
  Sigma.ι (fun _ : SingSimplexCat n X => ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) σ

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_basis
statement:
noncomputable def singChain_basis {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : SingSimplex n X) : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ singChain n X :=
  singChain_basisCat ((singSimplexEquiv n X).symm s)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_descCat
statement:
noncomputable def singChain_descCat {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {Y : ModuleCat ℤ} (φ : SingSimplexCat n X → (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ Y)) :
    singChain n X ⟶ Y :=
  Sigma.desc φ

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_desc
statement:
noncomputable def singChain_desc {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {Y : ModuleCat ℤ} (φ : SingSimplex n X → (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ Y)) :
    singChain n X ⟶ Y

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_descCat_basisCat
statement:
theorem singChain_descCat_basisCat {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {Y : ModuleCat ℤ} (φ : SingSimplexCat n X → (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ Y))
    (σ : SingSimplexCat n X) :
    singChain_basisCat σ ≫ singChain_descCat φ = φ σ

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_desc_basis
statement:
theorem singChain_desc_basis {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {Y : ModuleCat ℤ} (φ : SingSimplex n X → (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ Y))
    (s : SingSimplex n X) :
    singChain_basis s ≫ singChain_desc φ = φ s

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_hom_extCat
statement:
theorem singChain_hom_extCat {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {Y : ModuleCat ℤ} (g₁ g₂ : singChain n X ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ σ : SingSimplexCat n X,
      singChain_basisCat σ ≫ g₁ = singChain_basisCat σ ≫ g₂) :
    g₁ = g₂

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_hom_ext
statement:
theorem singChain_hom_ext {n : ℕ} {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {Y : ModuleCat ℤ} (g₁ g₂ : singChain n X ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ s : SingSimplex n X,
      singChain_basis s ≫ g₁ = singChain_basis s ≫ g₂) :
    g₁ = g₂

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_map_basisCat
statement:
theorem singChain_map_basisCat {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X, Y)) (n : ℕ) (σ : SingSimplexCat n X) :
    singChain_basisCat σ ≫
        (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom f)).f n =
      singChain_basisCat ((TopCat.toSSet.map (TopCat.ofHom f)).app _ σ)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singSimplexEquiv_toSSet_map
statement:
theorem singSimplexEquiv_toSSet_map {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X, Y)) (n : ℕ) (σ : SingSimplexCat n X) :
    (singSimplexEquiv n Y) ((TopCat.toSSet.map (TopCat.ofHom f)).app _ σ) =
      f.comp ((singSimplexEquiv n X) σ)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_map_basis
statement:
theorem singChain_map_basis {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X, Y)) (n : ℕ) (s : SingSimplex n X) :
    singChain_basis s ≫
        (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom f)).f n =
      singChain_basis (f.comp s)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_d_basisCat
statement:
theorem singChain_d_basisCat {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)
    (σ : SingSimplexCat (n + 1) X) :
    singChain_basisCat σ ≫
        (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj (TopCat.of X)).d (n + 1) n =
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val) •
        singChain_basisCat
          ((TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).map (SimplexCategory.δ j).op σ)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.stdSimplexFaceInclusion
statement:
noncomputable def stdSimplexFaceInclusion (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :=
  ⟨stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove j), stdSimplex.continuous_map _⟩

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singSimplexEquiv_face
statement:
theorem singSimplexEquiv_face {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)
    (j : Fin (n + 2)) (σ : SingSimplexCat (n + 1) X) :
    (singSimplexEquiv n X)
        ((TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).map (SimplexCategory.δ j).op σ) =
      ((singSimplexEquiv (n + 1) X) σ).comp (stdSimplexFaceInclusion n j)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singChain_d_basis
statement:
theorem singChain_d_basis {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (n + 1) X) :
    singChain_basis s ≫
        (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj (TopCat.of X)).d (n + 1) n =
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val) •
        singChain_basis (s.comp (stdSimplexFaceInclusion n j))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.SingularChain
statement:
noncomputable abbrev SingularChain (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ) :
    ModuleCat ℤ :=
  (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
    (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj (TopCat.of X)).X n

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singularChainSimplexIndex
statement:
noncomputable def singularChainSimplexIndex
    (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ) :
    C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X) ≃
      (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).obj (op ⦋n⦌) :=
  (TopCat.toSSetObjEquiv (TopCat.of X) (op ⦋n⦌)).symm

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.SingularChainCoproduct
statement:
noncomputable abbrev SingularChainCoproduct
    (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ) : ModuleCat ℤ :=
  ∐ (fun _ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).obj (op ⦋n⦌) =>
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singularChainElement
statement:
noncomputable def singularChainElement
    {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {n : ℕ}
    (σ : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X)) :
    SingularChainCoproduct X n :=
  let s : (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).obj (op ⦋n⦌) :=
    singularChainSimplexIndex X n σ
  (Sigma.ι (fun _ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)).obj (op ⦋n⦌) =>
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) s).hom (1 : ℤ)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.stdSimplexFaceMap
statement:
noncomputable def stdSimplexFaceMap
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :=
  ⟨stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove i), stdSimplex.continuous_map _⟩

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singularSimplexFace
statement:
noncomputable def singularSimplexFace
    {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {n : ℕ}
    (σ : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), X)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X) :=
  σ.comp (stdSimplexFaceMap n i)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.sigmaConst_obj_map_ι
statement:
lemma sigmaConst_obj_map_ι
    {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (a : α) :
    (Sigma.ι (fun _ : α => ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) a : _ ⟶ _)
        ≫ Sigma.map' f (fun _ => 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ))
      = Sigma.ι (fun _ : β => ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) (f a)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singularChainElement_boundary_decomposition
statement:
theorem singularChainElement_boundary_decomposition
    (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)
    (σ : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), X)) :
    (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj (TopCat.of X)).d (n + 1) n
        (singularChainElement σ : SingularChainCoproduct X (n + 1)) =
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 2))).sum
        fun i => ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) •
          (singularChainElement (singularSimplexFace σ i) :
            SingularChainCoproduct X n))

theorem edgeChain_isCycle (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * (g + 1))) :

        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj (TopCat.of (Polygon4g (g + 1)))).d 1 0

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.edgeChainOnGenus

noncomputable def edgeChainOnGenus (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * g)) :
    SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g g) 1 := by
  cases g with
  | zero =>

theorem edgeChainOnGenus_isCycle (g : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * g)) :

        (edgeChainOnGenus g i : SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g g) 1)
      = 0

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseFirstCoord
statement:
def staircaseFirstCoord (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ :=
  if k.val < i.val then f k.castSucc
  else if k.val = i.val then f i.castSucc + f i.succ
  else f k.succ
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseTimeCoord
statement:
def staircaseTimeCoord (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (n + 2) => i.val < j.val), f j
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseFirstCoord_eq
statement:
theorem staircaseFirstCoord_eq
    (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    staircaseFirstCoord n i f k =
      (if k = i then f i.castSucc else 0) + f (i.castSucc.succAbove k)
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseFirstCoord_sum
statement:
theorem staircaseFirstCoord_sum
    (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) :
    ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), staircaseFirstCoord n i f k = ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), f j
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseFirstCoord_nonneg
statement:
theorem staircaseFirstCoord_nonneg
    (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    0 ≤ staircaseFirstCoord n i f k
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseTimeCoord_nonneg
statement:
theorem staircaseTimeCoord_nonneg
    (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) :
    0 ≤ staircaseTimeCoord n i f
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseTimeCoord_le_one
statement:
theorem staircaseTimeCoord_le_one
    (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) (hsum : ∑ j, f j = 1) :
    staircaseTimeCoord n i f ≤ 1
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseFun
statement:
def staircaseFun (f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ) : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ :=
  (staircaseFirstCoord n i f, staircaseTimeCoord n i f)
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.continuous_staircaseFirstCoord
statement:
theorem continuous_staircaseFirstCoord :
    Continuous (fun f : Fin (n + 2) → ℝ => staircaseFirstCoord n i f)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismSimplex

noncomputable def prismSimplex
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseTimeCoord_face_self
statement:
theorem staircaseTimeCoord_face_self
    (f : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    staircaseTimeCoord n i
      (fun m : Fin (n + 2) =>
        Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun k : Fin (n + 1) =>
          if Fin.succAbove i.castSucc k = m then f k else 0)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => i.val ≤ k.val), f k
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.staircaseTimeCoord_face_succ
statement:
theorem staircaseTimeCoord_face_succ
    (f : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    staircaseTimeCoord n i
      (fun m : Fin (n + 2) =>
        Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun k : Fin (n + 1) =>
          if Fin.succAbove i.succ k = m then f k else 0)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin (n + 1) => i.val < k.val), f k
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

theorem staircaseTimeCoord_face_i_zero_sum_eq_one

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismSimplex_top_face
statement:
theorem prismSimplex_top_face
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (s : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X)) :
    ∀ p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
    prismSimplex n ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩ H s
        (stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ (n + 1)⟩) p) =
      g (s p)

    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (s : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X)) :
    ∀ p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
    prismSimplex n ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩ H s
        (stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove (Fin.last (n + 1))) p) =

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismSimplex_diagonal_face
statement:
theorem prismSimplex_diagonal_face
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (s : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), X))
    (ι : Fin n) :
    ∀ p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
    prismSimplex n ⟨ι.val, Nat.lt_trans ι.isLt (Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩ H s
        (stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove (⟨ι.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 2))) p) =
    prismSimplex n ⟨ι.val + 1, by omega⟩ H s
        (stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove (⟨ι.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 2))) p)
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismSimplex_side_face_lower
statement:
theorem prismSimplex_side_face_lower
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)) (j : Fin (n + 3))
    (hj_lt : j.val < i.val)
    (s : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), X)) :
    ∀ p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
    prismSimplex (n + 1) i H s
        (stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove j) p) =
    prismSimplex n
        ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩ H
        (s.comp ⟨stdSimplex.map
            (Fin.succAbove (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 2))),
          stdSimplex.continuous_map _⟩) p
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismSimplex_side_face_upper
statement:
theorem prismSimplex_side_face_upper
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)) (j : Fin (n + 3))
    (hj : i.val + 1 < j.val)
    (s : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), X)) :
    ∀ p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
    prismSimplex (n + 1) i H s
        (stdSimplex.map (Fin.succAbove j) p) =
    prismSimplex n
        ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ H
        (s.comp ⟨stdSimplex.map
            (Fin.succAbove ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩),
          stdSimplex.continuous_map _⟩) p
variables: variable (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismIndex
statement: abbrev prismIndex (i' : ℕ) : Type := Fin (i' + 2) × Fin (i' + 3)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismIndex.top
statement:
def prismIndex.top (i' : ℕ) : prismIndex i' :=
  (⟨0, by omega⟩, ⟨0, by omega⟩)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismIndex.bot
statement:
def prismIndex.bot (i' : ℕ) : prismIndex i' :=
  (⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩, ⟨i' + 2, by omega⟩)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismIndex.diagUpper
statement:
def prismIndex.diagUpper (i' : ℕ) (l : Fin (i' + 1)) : prismIndex i' :=
  (⟨l.val, by have := l.isLt; omega⟩, ⟨l.val + 1, by have := l.isLt; omega⟩)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismIndex.diagLower
statement:
def prismIndex.diagLower (i' : ℕ) (l : Fin (i' + 1)) : prismIndex i' :=
  (⟨l.val + 1, by have := l.isLt; omega⟩, ⟨l.val + 1, by have := l.isLt; omega⟩)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_LHS_summand
statement:
def prismChain_LHS_summand
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) (lj : prismIndex i') :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ singChain (i' + 1) Y :=
  ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (lj.1.val + 1 + lj.2.val)) • singChain_basis
    ((prismSimplex (i' + 1) lj.1 H s).comp (stdSimplexFaceInclusion (i' + 1) lj.2))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_dNext_summand
statement:
def prismChain_dNext_summand
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X)
    (j' : Fin (i' + 2)) (l' : Fin (i' + 1)) :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ singChain (i' + 1) Y :=
  ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j'.val + l'.val + 1)) • singChain_basis
    (prismSimplex i' l' H (s.comp (stdSimplexFaceInclusion i' j')))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_topContribution
statement:
theorem prismChain_topContribution
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) :
    prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s (prismIndex.top i') =
      -singChain_basis (g.comp s)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_bottomContribution
statement:
theorem prismChain_bottomContribution
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) :
    prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s (prismIndex.bot i') =
      singChain_basis (f.comp s)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_diagonalCancellation
statement:
theorem prismChain_diagonalCancellation
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) (l : Fin (i' + 1)) :
    prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s (prismIndex.diagUpper i' l) +
      prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s (prismIndex.diagLower i' l) = 0

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_lowerSideReindex
statement:
theorem prismChain_lowerSideReindex
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) :
    (∑ lj ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (prismIndex i')).filter
        (fun lj => lj.2.val < lj.1.val),
      prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s lj) =
      -(∑ jl ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (i' + 2) × Fin (i' + 1))).filter
          (fun jl => jl.1.val ≤ jl.2.val),
        prismChain_dNext_summand H i' s jl.1 jl.2)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_upperSideReindex
statement:
theorem prismChain_upperSideReindex
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) :
    (∑ lj ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (prismIndex i')).filter
        (fun lj => lj.1.val + 1 < lj.2.val),
      prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s lj) =
      -(∑ jl ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (i' + 2) × Fin (i' + 1))).filter
          (fun jl => jl.2.val < jl.1.val),
        prismChain_dNext_summand H i' s jl.1 jl.2)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.diagUpper_injective
statement:
private lemma diagUpper_injective (i' : ℕ) :

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.diagLower_injective
statement:
private lemma diagLower_injective (i' : ℕ) :

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_LHS_eq_partition
statement:
theorem prismChain_LHS_eq_partition
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) :
    (∑ lj : prismIndex i', prismChain_LHS_summand H i' s lj) =
      -singChain_basis (g.comp s) + singChain_basis (f.comp s)
        - (∑ jl : Fin (i' + 2) × Fin (i' + 1),
            prismChain_dNext_summand H i' s jl.1 jl.2)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_summand
statement:
noncomputable def prismChain_summand
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (s : SingSimplex n X) :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ singChain (n + 1) Y :=
  ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1)) • singChain_basis (prismSimplex n i H s)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_op_atSimplex
statement:
noncomputable def prismChain_op_atSimplex
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (n : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex n X) :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ singChain (n + 1) Y :=
  ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), prismChain_summand H n i s

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_op
statement:
noncomputable def prismChain_op
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (n : ℕ) :
    singChain n X ⟶ singChain (n + 1) Y :=
  singChain_desc (prismChain_op_atSimplex H n)

/-- Universal property: the prism operator on a basis element. -/
@[simp]

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_op_basis
statement:
theorem prismChain_op_basis
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (n : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex n X) :
    singChain_basis s ≫ prismChain_op H n =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), prismChain_summand H n i s

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_hom
statement:
noncomputable def prismChain_hom
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i j : ℕ) :
    singChain i X ⟶ singChain j Y := by
  by_cases h : j = i + 1
  · exact h ▸ prismChain_op H i
  · exact 0

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_hom_zero
statement:
theorem prismChain_hom_zero
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : ¬ (ComplexShape.down ℕ).Rel j i) :
    prismChain_hom H i j = 0

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_hom_succ
statement:
theorem prismChain_hom_succ
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i : ℕ) :
    prismChain_hom H i (i + 1) = prismChain_op H i

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_hom_comm_zero
statement:
theorem prismChain_hom_comm_zero
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) :
    (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom f)).f 0 =
      dNext 0 (prismChain_hom H) + prevD 0 (prismChain_hom H) +
      (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom g)).f 0

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_succ_combinatorial_identity
statement:
theorem prismChain_succ_combinatorial_identity
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i' : ℕ)
    (s : SingSimplex (i' + 1) X) :
    (∑ l : Fin (i' + 2), prismChain_summand H (i' + 1) l s
      ≫ (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).obj
          (TopCat.of Y)).d (i' + 2) (i' + 1)) =
      -singChain_basis (g.comp s) + singChain_basis (f.comp s)
        - (∑ j : Fin (i' + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val) •
          (singChain_basis (s.comp (stdSimplexFaceInclusion i' j))
          ≫ prismChain_op H i'))

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChain_hom_comm
statement:
theorem prismChain_hom_comm
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) (i : ℕ) :
    (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom f)).f i =
      dNext i (prismChain_hom H) + prevD i (prismChain_hom H) +
      (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom g)).f i

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.prismChainHomotopy
statement:
noncomputable def prismChainHomotopy
    {X Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g) :
    Homotopy
      (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map (TopCat.ofHom f))
      (((singularChainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj

statement:
theorem prism_chainHomotopy_exists

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.singularH1
statement:
abbrev singularH1 (M : Type) [TopologicalSpace M] : Type :=

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.Letter
statement:
inductive Letter (g : ℕ) : Type where
  | a    (i : Fin g) : Letter g

  | bInv (i : Fin g) : Letter g

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.EdgeWord
statement: abbrev EdgeWord (g : ℕ) : Type := List (Letter g)

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.EdgeWord.handleBlock
statement:
def handleBlock {g : ℕ} (i : Fin g) : List (Letter g) :=
  [Letter.a i, Letter.b i, Letter.aInv i, Letter.bInv i]

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.EdgeWord.standardWord
statement:
def standardWord (g : ℕ) : EdgeWord g :=
  (List.finRange g).flatMap handleBlock

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.EdgeWord.IsStandardForm
statement:
def IsStandardForm {g : ℕ} (w : EdgeWord g) : Prop :=

  | ax_aInv {g : ℕ} (i : Fin g) (xs ys : List (Letter g)) :
      InverseCancel (xs ++ [Letter.a i, Letter.aInv i] ++ ys) (xs ++ ys)
  | aInv_a {g : ℕ} (i : Fin g) (xs ys : List (Letter g)) :
      InverseCancel (xs ++ [Letter.aInv i, Letter.a i] ++ ys) (xs ++ ys)
  | bx_bInv {g : ℕ} (i : Fin g) (xs ys : List (Letter g)) :
      InverseCancel (xs ++ [Letter.b i, Letter.bInv i] ++ ys) (xs ++ ys)
  | bInv_b {g : ℕ} (i : Fin g) (xs ys : List (Letter g)) :
      InverseCancel (xs ++ [Letter.bInv i, Letter.b i] ++ ys) (xs ++ ys)

  | swap   {g : ℕ} {w v : EdgeWord g} (h : HandleSwap w v) : TietzeStep w v

structure Polygon4gBoundaryArcStep (g : ℕ) where
  source : DiskC
  target : DiskC
  edgeIndex : Fin (2 * (g + 1))
  arcIndex : ℕ
  arcIndex_represents_edge :
    arcIndex = edgeArcIdx g edgeIndex ∨
      arcIndex = edgeArcIdx g edgeIndex + 2
  orientation : BoundaryArcOrientation
  startParam : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  endParam : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  path : C(unitInterval, DiskC)
  source_eq : path 0 = source
  target_eq : path 1 = target
  path_param :
    ∀ t : unitInterval,
      path t = boundaryParam (g + 1) arcIndex
        (boundaryArcOrientedAffineParam orientation startParam endParam t)

    DiskC → DiskC → List (Polygon4gBoundaryArcStep g) → Prop
  | nil (p : DiskC) : Polygon4gBoundaryArcListConnects g p p []
  | cons {p q r : DiskC} {step : Polygon4gBoundaryArcStep g}
      {steps : List (Polygon4gBoundaryArcStep g)}
      (hsource : step.source = p)

  first_endpoint :

  n : ℕ

  subdivision_valid : SingularOneSimplexSubdivisionData n subSimplex

  projects_on_piece :
    ∀ (i : Fin n) (s : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin 2)),
      Polygon4g.mk (g + 1) (lift i s) = σ (subSimplex i s)
  adjacent_endpoint_rel :
    ∀ (i j : Fin n), i.1 + 1 = j.1 →
      Polygon4g.SideRel (g + 1)

  subdivisionBoundary : SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g (g + 1)) 2
  subdivision_homology :
    (singularChainComplexZ (Polygon4g (g + 1))).d 2 1 subdivisionBoundary =
      subdividedChain - singularChainElement σ

structure Polygon4gEndpointRepairData
    (g : ℕ) (p q : DiskC)
    (_hrel : Polygon4g.SideRel (g + 1) p q) where
  coeff : Polygon4gAbelianization g
  diskRepairChain : SingularChainCoproduct DiskC 1
  projectedRepairChain : SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g (g + 1)) 1
  edgeChainBoundary : SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g (g + 1)) 2
  steps : List (Polygon4gBoundaryArcStep g)
  steps_connect : Polygon4gBoundaryArcListConnects g p q steps
  diskRepairChain_eq :
    diskRepairChain =
      (steps.map fun step =>
        step.orientation.sign • singularChainElement
          (step.path.comp stdSimplexToUnitInterval)).sum
  projectedRepairChain_eq :
    projectedRepairChain = polygon4gBoundaryArcStepsProjectedChain g steps
  diskRepairBoundary :
    (singularChainComplexZ DiskC).d 1 0 diskRepairChain =
      pointChain DiskC q - pointChain DiskC p
  projectedRepairBoundary :
    (singularChainComplexZ (Polygon4g (g + 1))).d 1 0
        projectedRepairChain =
      pointChain (Polygon4g (g + 1)) (Polygon4g.mk (g + 1) q) -
        pointChain (Polygon4g (g + 1)) (Polygon4g.mk (g + 1) p)
  projectedRepair_homologous_edge :
    (singularChainComplexZ (Polygon4g (g + 1))).d 2 1 edgeChainBoundary =
      projectedRepairChain -
        ∑ e : Fin (2 * (g + 1)), coeff e • edgeChain g e

  edgeCoeffs : Polygon4gAbelianization g
  diskRepairSum : SingularChainCoproduct DiskC 1
  diskCycle : SingularChainCoproduct DiskC 1
  diskCycle_eq : diskCycle = lifted.liftedDiskChain - diskRepairSum
  diskCycle_isCycle : (singularChainComplexZ DiskC).d 1 0 diskCycle = 0
  projectedRepairSum : SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g (g + 1)) 1
  projectedRepairSum_eq_chainMap_diskRepairSum :

          (TopCat.ofHom (polygon4gMkContinuousMap (g + 1)))).f 1)
      diskRepairSum =
      projectedRepairSum
  projectedRepairBoundary :
    (singularChainComplexZ (Polygon4g (g + 1))).d 1 0 projectedRepairSum =
      (@Finset.univ pairs.Pair pairs.pairFintype).sum
        (fun pair =>
          pointChain (Polygon4g (g + 1))

              (Polygon4g.mk (g + 1) (pairs.leftEndpoint pair)))
  edgeChainBoundarySum : SingularChainCoproduct (Polygon4g (g + 1)) 2
  projectedRepair_homologous_edge :

name: JacobianChallenge.Periods.IsCanonicalEdgeArcResidue

statement:
theorem riemann_bilinear_identity
    (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    [ConnectedSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X]
    [FiniteDimensionalHolomorphicOneForms ℂ X]
    (σ : Fin (2 * analyticGenus ℂ X) → IntegralOneCycle X)
    (_hσ : Function.Injective σ) :
    ∃ Q : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X → HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X → ℂ,
      (∀ ω η, Q ω η = -Q η ω) ∧
      (∀ ω η, Q ω η = ∑ k : Fin (analyticGenus ℂ X),
                        (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩)) ω *
                           ((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩)) η -
                         ((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩)) ω *
                           ((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩)) η))

statement:
theorem hodge_form_posDef_on_periods
    (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [CompactSpace X]
    [ConnectedSpace X] [ChartedSpace ℂ X]
    [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℂ ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) X]
    [FiniteDimensionalHolomorphicOneForms ℂ X]
    (σ : Fin (2 * analyticGenus ℂ X) → IntegralOneCycle X)
    (hσ_stokes : ∀ ω : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X,
      (∑ k : Fin (analyticGenus ℂ X),
        (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩)) ω *
           (starRingEnd ℂ (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩)) ω)) -
         ((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩)) ω *
           (starRingEnd ℂ (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩)) ω)))) =
      (-Complex.I) * ∑ i : Fin (analyticGenus ℂ X),
        ((holomorphicOneFormFinBasis ℂ X).repr ω i) *
        (starRingEnd ℂ ((holomorphicOneFormFinBasis ℂ X).repr ω i))) :
    ∀ ω : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X,
      ω ≠ 0 → (Complex.I * (∑ k : Fin (analyticGenus ℂ X),
                        (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩)) ω *
                           (starRingEnd ℂ (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩)) ω)) -
                         ((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩)) ω *
                           (starRingEnd ℂ (((periodPairing ℂ X) (σ ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩)) ω))))).re > 0

name: JacobianChallenge.HolomorphicForms.TraceFormsConstructionData
statement:
structure TraceFormsConstructionData
    (f : X → Y) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) f)
    (η : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X) where
  /-- The global bundled trace form of `η` along `f`. -/
  traceForm : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ Y
  /--
At every regular value of any compatible branched-cover datum on
  `f`, the global form agrees with the finite local fiber sum.
-/
  regular_spec :
    ∀ (hbc : BranchedCoverData X Y f) (_hcompat : hbc.RamificationIndexCompatible)
      (y : Y) (hy : isRegularValue hbc y),
      traceForm.toFun y = traceAtRegularValue hbc (fun x => η.toFun x) y hy
  /-- The zero input form maps to the zero global form. -/
  map_zero_spec : η = 0 → traceForm = 0

private theorem chartLocal_zPow_form_of_ramified
    [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) ω X] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) ω Y]
    {f : X → Y} {x₀ : X} (hf : IsHolomorphicAt f x₀)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hram : mapAnalyticOrderAt f x₀ = k) :
    ∃ φ : ℂ → ℂ,
      AnalyticAt ℂ φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀) ∧
      φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀) = 0 ∧
      deriv φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀),
        chartLocalAt f x₀ z - chartAt ℂ (f x₀) (f x₀) = φ z ^ k

    {f : X → Y} {x₀ : X} {k : ℕ} (_hk : 0 < k)
    {φ : ℂ → ℂ} (hφ_an : AnalyticAt ℂ φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀))
    (hφ_eq : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀),
      chartLocalAt f x₀ z - chartAt ℂ (f x₀) (f x₀) = φ z ^ k) :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀),
      deriv (chartLocalAt f x₀) z =
        (k : ℂ) * φ z ^ (k - 1) * deriv φ z

statement:
private theorem ramified_kfold_chart_bijection
    (f : X → Y) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ) (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) f)
    (hbc : BranchedCoverData X Y f) (hcompat : hbc.RamificationIndexCompatible)
    (y₀ : Y) (x₀ : X) (hx₀_fiber : f x₀ = y₀)
    (k : ℕ) (hk_pos : 0 < k) (hk_ram : k = hbc.ramificationIndex x₀)
    (U_kfold : Set X) (hU_kfold_open : IsOpen U_kfold) (hxU_kfold : x₀ ∈ U_kfold) :
    ∃ (φ r kthRoot : ℂ → ℂ) (ζ : ℂ),
      AnalyticAt ℂ φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀) ∧
      φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀) = 0 ∧
      deriv φ (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀) ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀),
        chartLocalAt f x₀ z - chartAt ℂ (f x₀) (f x₀) = φ z ^ k) ∧
      (∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ), φ (r ε) = ε) ∧
      (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀), r (φ z) = z) ∧
      r 0 = chartAt ℂ x₀ x₀ ∧
      (∀ w : ℂ, (kthRoot w) ^ k = w) ∧
      kthRoot 0 = 0 ∧
      ContinuousAt kthRoot 0 ∧
      IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k ∧
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, y ≠ y₀ → ∀ (s : Finset X),
        s.card = k → (↑s : Set X) ⊆ U_kfold →
        (∀ x' ∈ s, f x' = y ∧ hbc.ramificationIndex x' = 1) →
        (∀ x' ∈ U_kfold, f x' = y → x' ∈ s) →
        ∃ e : Fin k → s,
          Function.Injective e ∧
          ∀ j : Fin k, (e j : X) =
            (chartAt ℂ x₀).symm
              (r ((ζ ^ (j : ℕ)) *
                (kthRoot (chartAt ℂ (f x₀) y - chartAt ℂ (f x₀) (f x₀)))))

  /-- Trace sends the zero form to zero. -/

      (η : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X)

    (η : HolomorphicOneForm ℂ X)
    (hbc_f : BranchedCoverData X Y f) (hcompat_f : hbc_f.RamificationIndexCompatible)
    (hbc_g : BranchedCoverData Y Z g) (hcompat_g : hbc_g.RamificationIndexCompatible)
    (hbc_gf : BranchedCoverData X Z (g ∘ f)) (hcompat_gf : hbc_gf.RamificationIndexCompatible)

      traceAtRegularValue hbc_g

statement:
theorem laplacian_eq_dirDeriv {f : ℂ → ℝ} {x : ℂ} (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    Δ f x = dirDeriv (dirDeriv f 1) 1 x + dirDeriv (dirDeriv f Complex.I) Complex.I x

statement:
theorem integral_mul_dirDeriv {f g : ℂ → ℝ} {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hgs : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hgU : tsupport g ⊆ U) (v : ℂ) :
    ∫ x, f x * dirDeriv g v x = -∫ x, dirDeriv f v x * g x
